title: Arcane Primary Charger
summary: Arcane Primary Charger is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 30% chance on killing an enemy with a melee weapon to increase the damage of primary weapons for 12 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Primary Charger is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 30% chance on killing an enemy with a melee weapon to increase the damage of primary weapons for 12 seconds.
Can be sold for  ‍1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded from Arbitrations missions.
Can be purchased from the Arbitrations vendor in the  Arbiters of Hexis room in Relays for 10  Vitus Essence.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The buff is additive to damage mods.
For example,  Braton with max  Serration and 200% bonus from  Arcane Primary Charger will have: 24.0 × (1 + 165% + 200%) = 111.6 damage
